name: computer-use-windows
description: Guarded Windows desktop observation and input automation using short-lived, one-action window state.

shortDescription.en-US: Observe and control selected Windows app windows from fresh state.
shortDescription.zh-CN: 基于最新状态观察并控制选定的 Windows 应用窗口。

longDescription.en-US: A high-risk local Windows automation plugin with a native per-display safety overlay, window-scoped screenshots, bounded accessibility state, one-action stale-state guards, and risk-gated input.
longDescription.zh-CN: 高风险本地 Windows 自动化插件，提供原生全显示器安全提示、窗口级截图、有界可访问性状态、一次性过期状态保护和按风险审批的输入。

permissions: Loads this plugin's Computer Use runtime inside Anybox's persistent, general-purpose Node REPL.
Starts the native helper shipped inside this plugin package after verifying its SHA-256 integrity.
Shows a non-disableable native blue safety indicator on every active display before desktop access.
Captures selected Windows app windows and sends mouse or keyboard input, prompting only for high-impact actions.
mcpRequirements.reason: Provides the Codex-style model surface: persistent JavaScript state with the plugin-owned sky API.

skillPreviews.name: Computer Use Windows
skillPreviews.description: Operate one approved Windows application at a time through fresh, one-action window state.
